title: Dependency and Indemnity Compensation (DIC) Surviving Spouse Rate Table
content:
Dependency and Indemnity Compensation (DIC) for a surviving spouse is held in one of six rate categories. The basic monthly rate shown is the rate effective December 1, 2025. All figures are in U.S. dollars per month unless a column states otherwise.

## Rate categories

Every category requires a qualifying death of the veteran (a service-connected death or a qualifying total disability) and a valid marriage to the veteran. The categories differ only in whether the 8-year provision is established on the award and in the surviving spouse's care level.

| Rate category | 8-year provision | Care level |
|---|---|---|
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Basic Rate) | Not established | Basic |
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Basic Rate with 8-Year Provision) | Established | Basic |
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Housebound) | Not established | Housebound |
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Housebound with 8-Year Provision) | Established | Housebound |
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Aid and Attendance) | Not established | Aid and attendance |
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Aid and Attendance with 8-Year Provision) | Established | Aid and attendance |

## Spouse rate and care-level additions (USD per month)

| Rate category | Basic monthly rate | 8-year addition | Housebound addition | Aid-and-attendance addition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Basic Rate) | 1699.36 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Basic Rate with 8-Year Provision) | 1699.36 | 360.70 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Housebound) | 1699.36 | 0.00 | 197.29 | 0.00 |
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Housebound with 8-Year Provision) | 1699.36 | 360.70 | 197.29 | 0.00 |
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Aid and Attendance) | 1699.36 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 421.16 |
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Aid and Attendance with 8-Year Provision) | 1699.36 | 360.70 | 0.00 | 421.16 |

A figure of 0.00 means the category carries no such addition.

## Child-related amounts

| Rate category | Child addition, per child under the child age limit (USD per month) | Transitional benefit, surviving spouse with a child under 18 (USD per month) | Transitional benefit period, from the start of DIC entitlement |
|---|---|---|---|
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Basic Rate) | 421.16 | 358.26 | 24 months |
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Basic Rate with 8-Year Provision) | 421.16 | 358.26 | 24 months |
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Housebound) | 421.16 | 358.26 | 24 months |
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Housebound with 8-Year Provision) | 421.16 | 358.26 | 24 months |
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Aid and Attendance) | 421.16 | 358.26 | 24 months |
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Aid and Attendance with 8-Year Provision) | 421.16 | 358.26 | 24 months |

## Rounding

In every rate category, monthly amounts are rounded to the cent.

## Notes on the table

- The basic monthly rate is the same 1699.36 in all six categories; the categories are told apart only by the three addition columns.
- The 8-year addition of 360.70 appears only in the three categories whose names include "with 8-Year Provision".
- No category carries both a housebound addition and an aid-and-attendance addition: the two housebound categories show 197.29 and no aid-and-attendance figure, and the two aid-and-attendance categories show 421.16 and no housebound figure.
- The child addition, the transitional benefit and the 24-month transitional period do not vary by category.

## Reading a row (hypothetical illustration)

Suppose an award is recorded in the DIC Surviving Spouse (Housebound with 8-Year Provision) category. Reading across its row, the figures that apply to it are a basic monthly rate of 1699.36, an 8-year addition of 360.70, a housebound addition of 197.29 and an aid-and-attendance addition of 0.00, and, from the child table, a child addition of 421.16, a transitional benefit of 358.26 and a transitional period of 24 months.
